# Forge

The forge puts permanent effects on the faces of your die. Open crates with meta points to get effects, then choose a face to put one on. **Each face holds one effect**, so six faces means six choices.

## Crates

Every crate draws from all 15 effects. Dearer crates can't land below a certain rarity, which takes the commons (and more) out of the draw.

Every 40th crate you open is **Rare or better**, whichever crate it is.

## Effects

The numbers along the bottom of each card are the chance of getting that exact effect from one crate. Weight effects make a face come up more or less often, so their size can't be given as a number.
